cues.say: Component 23: Security basics. Five things in one breath: HTTPS, secrets in a vault, the provider handles cards, least privilege, little personal data. You'll bring this up during go-live prep.
Think of it as: Lock the doors, keep the keys in a safe, let the bank hold the cash. Use it for when asked.
Here's a real scenario. The interviewer asks: What about security?.
Weak answer: 10 minutes on encryption algorithms.
Stripe key and database password in a secrets manager.
No card numbers, thanks to hosted checkout.
Text worker can read the queue, not the database.
Store only a name and phone number.
Why it works: It shows you know the basics, in 20 seconds.
In the interview, say: HTTPS everywhere, secrets in a vault, no card data on our servers, and each service gets only what it needs.
A few related terms you may hear.
Authorization: What you're allowed to do.
Least privilege: Each part gets only what it needs.
